title: Mostra protocol types: IDs, revisions and diagnostics

Actor.description: Who caused an event or wrote a field: a viewer, an agent, a host or Mostra.

AddedPackage.description: A package deps/add settled: its name, exact version and whether it is warm.

ArtifactDetail.description: One artifact in full: its summary, the latest manifest and every version.

ArtifactId.description: Artifact ID: "art_" followed by a 26-character ULID.

ArtifactLink.description: A related artifact: how this one relates (rel) and the other artifact's ID.

ArtifactManifest.description: The artifact manifest (INTERFACES §2.2): literal metadata from the entry's defineArtifact call or MDX frontmatter.

ArtifactRef.description: Names an artifact by its ID or by an absolute source path bound to it.

ArtifactSummary.description: One artifact: metadata from its latest version, its source and latest version.

CapabilityLink.description: A capability URL with its token ID, scopes and expiry.

CapabilityScope.description: A capability token's scope: view, draft, submit, review, signal, action:*, action:<export> or action:<module path>#<export>.

CarryOver.description: The viewer's answers a version doesn't carry over.

ChildProcessStatus.description: One child process the instance supervises.

ChooseRequest.description: The shell's trusted Choose: the view, mutation, base revision, set and candidate.

ClientCapabilities.description: What the client can handle: the notification methods it accepts.

ClientInfo.description: The client that opens a connection.

CommentId.description: Comment ID: "cmt_" followed by a 26-character ULID.

ControlsPolicy.description: Which submit channels a view accepts and which trusted controls its shell renders (D108).

Cursor.description: Event cursor: the decimal string of a home-wide event position.

DeliveryCounts.description: One host's deliveries by state, and whether it is connected.

DeliveryId.description: Delivery ID: "dlv_" followed by a 26-character ULID.

DeliveryStatus.description: One submission's delivery to one host: owner, state, attempts and reason.

DependencyPolicy.description: How packages enter an artifact's lockfile: auto installs what artifacts import; explicit only what deps/add adds (D43).

Diagnostic.description: One diagnostic: a stable code, severity, message, hint, fix and docs link.

DiagnosticFix.description: A machine-applicable fix; range is [startLine, startColumn, endLine, endColumn], 1-based, end exclusive.

DiagnosticLocation.description: A 1-based source position, or a place in a rendered viewport.

DiagnosticPhase.description: The stage of work that produced the diagnostic.

DiagnosticSeverity.description: How bad it is: error only for definite failures.

DocumentRevision.description: A draft's or artifact state's revision: a non-negative decimal integer string.

DocumentSnapshot.description: A document's revision, epoch and fields, as a page loads it.

DraftMirror.description: A viewer's draft mirrored to a host: always kind draft, never a submission.

Duration.description: A duration: a positive whole number and s, m, h or d, such as 30m, 24h or 7d.

EventFilter.description: Which events a reader wants: these artifacts' and these types (patterns allowed).

EventRecord.description: One durable event: cursor, artifact, per-artifact sequence, type, time, actor, payload.

EventTypePattern.description: An event type (submission.created) or a family of them (submission.*).

EventsNotifyParams.description: A subscription's next events, in cursor order, and the cursor examined up to.

FieldConflict.description: A field op not applied because the field changed after the base revision.

FieldOp.description: One change to one field: a value or a delete, with optional label, required and sensitive.

FieldState.description: A field's current value, the revision that wrote it, who wrote it and when.

FieldsRequest.description: A browser mutation: its ID, scope, base revision, view and field ops.

FollowRequest.description: Whether the viewer follows the artifact's new versions.

FrameTicket.description: A frame ticket: the view it opens, where to load it, and the view's controls.

HomeConfig.description: Home settings from a spawning host; path is a check against the instance's home (D84), dependencies the dependency policy (D43), submission the home's policy (D102), ports those the host always provides (D105).

InstanceCapabilities.description: What the instance offers: methods, notifications and supported ports.

InstanceInfo.description: The instance a client is connected to.

JsonRpcErrorObject.description: The error of a failed JSON-RPC 2.0 response; Mostra puts the diagnostic in data.

JsonRpcFailure.description: A failed JSON-RPC 2.0 response; id is null when the request's id was unreadable.

JsonRpcNotification.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 notification: a request without an id, never answered.

JsonRpcRequest.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request: answered by a response with the same id.

MutationId.description: Mutation ID: "mut_" followed by a 26-character ULID.

MutationResult.description: A mutation's outcome: the revision after it, the applied field IDs, the conflicts.

OrphanedField.description: A draft field a version doesn't cover: its ID, label, value and source version.

PollResult.description: A long-poll answer: the cursor, the events after the asked one, and a snapshot.

PortName.description: A host port name: identity, submissions, drafts, reviews, addressing, trustedControls, capture, secrets, pty, or ai (reserved). Open for later ports.

PortTrustedControlsActivatedParams.description: A trusted control a person used: the artifact, control, viewer, view and detail.

PortTrustedControlsPolicyParams.description: The artifact a frame is about to show, for its host's controls policy.

PublishReceipt.description: The receipt of artifact/publish: artifact, version, number, capability URL when served, event cursor, reuse.

ResultComment.description: One comment thread in results: messages, anchor layers and the screenshot crop.

Results.description: The complete submission: artifact, submission facts, answers, fields, state, choices, comments, orphans, actions, signals.

ResultsMarkdown.description: A submission's results as Markdown for agents.

Revision.description: Protocol revision: a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

RunId.description: Action run ID: "run_" followed by a 26-character ULID.

ShellSubmitRequest.description: The shell's trusted Submit: the view and the draft revision the viewer saw.

SignalRequest.description: A browser signal: the view, the signal's name and an optional JSON payload.

SourceRef.description: Where to build an artifact from: an absolute source path, or an artifact ID (its last published source path).

StreamSnapshot.description: Where a page stands: cursor, viewer, draft, artifact state and its submission.

SubmissionEnvelope.description: One submission delivered to a host: delivery ID, attempt and the complete results.

SubmissionId.description: Submission ID: "sub_" followed by a 26-character ULID.

SubmissionPolicy.description: A submission policy: once (per-artifact or per-viewer), epochs, or none.

SubmissionSummary.description: A submission as a submit answers it: ID, time, epoch, version, view, digest, delivery.

SubmitChannel.description: Where a submit comes from: the shell's trusted Submit, or the artifact's code.

SubmitRequest.description: A browser submit: the view and the draft revision the viewer saw.

ThreadId.description: Thread ID: "thr_" followed by a 26-character ULID.

TokenId.description: Capability token ID: "tok_" followed by a 26-character ULID.

TrustedControl.description: A trusted control the shell renders: submit, choose, approve; open for more.

VersionId.description: Version ID: "ver_" followed by 26 characters of Crockford base32.

VersionRef.description: A version by ID and number.

ViewContext.description: What one view is: its artifact, view ID, version, latest version, policy, channels and controls.

ViewId.description: View ID: "vw_" followed by a 26-character ULID.

Viewer.description: A person who views an artifact: ID, kind, display name and the host's own key.

ViewerId.description: Viewer ID: "vwr_" followed by a 26-character ULID.

ViewerSpec.description: The person a capability link acts for: the host's stable key and a display name.

WaitCondition.description: What wait waits for: submitted, signal:<name>, state:<fieldId> or event:<type>.
